definitions: Robert Rauschenberg (1925–2008) was an American painter and graphic artist whose early works anticipated the Pop art movement. He is well known for his 'combines' (1950s), which incorporated everyday objects as art materials.
examples: Rauschenberg's 'combines' blurred the lines between painting and sculpture.
The exhibition featured several key works by Rauschenberg.
Rauschenberg was a pivotal figure in post-war American art.
